question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

My friend’s business has grown __by leaps and bounds.__
solution:
```html

The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. rapidly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"by leaps and bounds"** means something that happens very quickly or grows very fast. (तेजी से)
 
 
• **Example:** The company's profits have increased by leaps and bounds since they launched their new product.
 
 
 
• **"Rapidly"** refers to something happening at a fast pace or with great speed. (तेजी से)
 
 
• **Example:** Technology is advancing rapidly in today's world.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. rapidly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Aimlessly** (बिना उद्देश्य के): Without any clear purpose or direction.
 
 
• **Example:** He wandered aimlessly through the streets, not knowing where to go.
 
 
 
• **Perfectly** (पूर्ण रूप से): In a manner that is flawless or without any mistakes.
 
 
• **Example:** She performed the task perfectly, leaving no room for errors.
 
 
 
• **Slowly** (धीरे-धीरे): At a slow pace or not quickly.
 
 
• **Example:** The turtle moved slowly across the road.
```
